records.title: Laya as a Typed Probabilistic Assessor: An Independent Reproduction and a Preregistered Study of Calibration and Selective Escalation
records.reason: Selective escalation is related to cascades, but the paper cannot measure an end-to-end cascade because no escalation target was run; weak efficiency evidence.

records.title: No Free Efficiency: Revisiting the Trade-off Between Training Efficiency and Model Vulnerability
records.reason: Examines security vulnerability tradeoffs of training efficiency; training-only.

records.title: Training Witnesses: Trusting the Training without Trusting the Trainer
records.reason: Certifies model training/data/evaluation with fingerprints; training provenance, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Validating Memory-Optimal Transformer Kernels on Real Hardware: From Formal Derivation to Measured Performance Across Two HPC Clusters
records.reason: It includes real decode measurements, but its main performance contribution and comparisons are narrow and do not establish an inference-serving improvement over existing kernels.

records.title: Optimizing the Phi-2 Small Language Model for Real-time Chatbot Applications Using Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) with QLoRA Quantization
records.reason: PEFT/QLoRA fine-tuning for Phi-2 chatbot deployment; the proposed optimization is model adaptation/training.
